facts.fact: Telecom Review Africa reports that Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel converted their December 2024 memorandum into a binding agreement on the Horizon Fiber terrestrial corridor from Djibouti's landing stations through Ethiopia to Sudan; the document gives no signing day, so its published date is used.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
